news.headline: Vanguard Capital Management discloses 5.17% beneficial stake in Nektar Therapeutics
news.summary: Vanguard and affiliated entities disclosed a passive beneficial ownership stake of 1,747,653 Nektar shares, representing 5.17% of the class, as of June 30, 2026. The Schedule 13G filing shows Vanguard holds sole dispositive power over the full position with more limited sole voting power.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Financial Results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, August 13, 2026, After Close of U.S.-Based Financial Markets
news.summary: Nektar confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) on August 13, 2026 after U.S. market close. CEO Howard Robin will host a conference call and webcast at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to review results.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, citing the commercial potential of rezpegaldesleukin. This contrasts with Wedbush's more cautious Neutral stance and $80 target set in May 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two of three global, randomized, placebo-controlled, 510-patient Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12+ with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3 for patients with prior biologic/JAK inhibitor experience, is planned to start in September 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares rose as sentiment across inflammation-and-immunology biotech names improved following AbbVie's announced $10.9 billion acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, with Canaccord flagging Nektar as a potential read-through beneficiary given its competing rezpegaldesleukin program in atopic dermatitis.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Added to Russell 2000 Index
news.summary: Following the annual FTSE Russell reconstitution completed June 27, 2026, Nektar was added to a broad suite of indices including the Russell 2000, 2500 and 3000 and related growth/value benchmarks, expanding its passive-fund investor base.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar has officially confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 13, 2026, after U.S. market close, with a CEO-hosted conference call and webcast at 5:00 p.m. ET.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: The third and final trial of the pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD program, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is planned to begin dosing.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Following completion of its End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting in Q2 2026, Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, pending final alignment with the FDA on trial design.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline results from the two ongoing Phase 3 ZENITH AD trials in atopic dermatitis are targeted for mid-2028, with a BLA submission planned for 2029 assuming positive data.

pulse: With Q2 2026 earnings now confirmed for August 13, Nektar heads into the print on a wave of positive momentum: the pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin officially began dosing on July 21, and Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $153 target shortly after, even as Wedbush remains cautious at Neutral/$80 given Dupixent's entrenched position. Passive ownership has broadened following June's Russell index reconstitution and a newly disclosed 5.17% Vanguard stake, while sector sentiment got an extra lift from AbbVie's $10.9 billion Apogee Therapeutics acquisition, seen as a read-through positive for Nektar's competing atopic-dermatitis franchise. With over $1 billion in cash funding runway into 2028, investors are now watching for the ZENITH AD-3 trial start in September and any updates on the planned early-2027 Phase 3 alopecia areata trial alongside the upcoming earnings call.
